property_summary: When transfer() completes successfully for a valid array of recipients, the reference contract returns true while the mutant returns false, detectable via a return value check.
Calling transfer with an empty tos array reverts on reference but succeeds on buggy version, making the call's revert boolean differ.

Call transfer with _tos containing two addresses and v containing [1, 2]; the reference reverts on the second iteration due to v[1] being greater than the token balance (or allowance), but the buggy version with i-- iterates indefinitely (or out-of-bounds) and does NOT revert — so the reference returns false (revert) while the buggy version either reverts with array out-of-bounds or hangs, which we detect by the call not reverting (i.e., returning true) in the buggy version versus reverting in the reference.
